_comment: How to read paymentOrder rows. The payload delivers Type and Severity as
display text with no accompanying vocabulary, so the known values and
their screen treatment are policy and live here.
_window_months_comment: RRM review window: returns inside the last N months before the report date are listed open and the timeline band highlights them; older returns fold away. This window is OURS -- AECB delivers events, not a window -- so everything derived from it is presentation, never data.
_types_comment: Delivered Type text -> instrument kind, matched after trimming (the payload carries trailing spaces). A Type matching neither is shown verbatim with a neutral marker -- never guessed into one of the two.
_severity_tones_comment: Delivered Severity text -> display tone. Single/Multiple/Reported is the full vocabulary per RRM (Aug 2026). 'Reported' is rendered neutral pending a business definition of what it grades; unknown values also render neutral rather than being guessed into a risk colour.
